data: What is the approximate value of the orange square at grade 10 for the bottom right plot?

The bottom right plot represents the Joy values across grades for both genders. The orange square at grade 10 corresponds to the male Joy value. By visually inspecting the plot, the orange square appears to be positioned around the 0.48 mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the orange square at grade 10 for the bottom right plot is 0.48.
